jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Avalon Healthcare Solutions****:** Avalon Healthcare Solutions is the nation’s leader in diagnostic intelligence, uniquely focused on transforming the role of diagnostic testing across the healthcare ecosystem. Our proprietary Diagnostic Insights Platform delivers evidence\-based policies, curated lab networks, and real\-time analytics that simplify complex diagnostics, accelerate innovation adoption, and optimize diagnostic investments. Supporting over 30 health plans and 100 million members nationwide, Avalon partners with payers and providers to ensure diagnostic testing is performed appropriately, efficiently, and at the right time. Our flexible solutions span routine and genetic testing management, automated adherence, and end\-to\-end diagnostics support—driving measurable value, reduced waste, and improved clinical outcomes. With unmatched scientific rigor, deep clinical expertise, and a performance\-based model, Avalon is redefining how diagnostics power personalized care and healthcare value. You will be part of a team that shapes a new market and business. Most importantly, you will help Avalon to achieve its mission and improve clinical outcomes and health care affordability for the people we serve. For more information about Avalon, please visit www.avalonhcs.com. Avalon Healthcare Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer \- Vet/Disability. This position description is subject to change at any time. As determined by the company based upon business needs, an employee in this position may be required to perform duties and take responsibility for work other than as described in this document. **About the AI Engineer Position****:** The AI Engineer is a senior technical contributor responsible for leading the design, development, and deployment of scalable AI\-powered solutions that support Avalon’s business objectives. This position owns complex AI features and projects from concept through production, including evaluating models and approaches, building reliable pipelines and integrations, and ensuring solutions meet high standards for accuracy, performance, and responsible use. While primarily focused on team objectives, the AI Engineer may also lead cross\-functional AI initiatives, coordinating efforts, aligning timelines, and partnering with Product, Design, and Data teams to translate business challenges into practical, measurable AI applications. This position works closely with principal engineers and architects to help shape AI strategy and technical direction, contribute to architectural decisions, and ensure AI systems remain consistent, secure, maintainable, and scalable across the platform. The AI Engineer serves as a key contributor to expanding AI expertise across the organization by mentoring employees, supporting adoption of AI tools and practices, providing code and model reviews, and promoting best practices related to prompt and model evaluation, data quality, observability, and responsible deployment. This role combines hands\-on technical execution with technical leadership and influence, helping advance Avalon’s AI capabilities while fostering a collaborative and innovative engineering culture. *This position is eligible for remote work, but quarterly travel will be required to Avalon’s corporate office located in Tampa, Florida.* **AI Engineer – Essential Functions and Responsibilities****:** * Contribute to the design, technical direction, and architecture of AI\-enabled solutions, collaborating with business and technical teams to build fit\-for\-purpose solutions that apply generative AI and agentic capabilities where they deliver measurable value. * Applies expert software engineering skills across a polyglot stack, including Python, Rust, Node.js/TypeScript, and Java, selecting the right language and runtime for each problem, and independently designs and develops key services with a focus on continuous integration and delivery. * Designs, builds, and operates agentic systems, including multi\-step and multi\-agent workflows, tool and function calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and integrations, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and agent memory and orchestration patterns. * Applies advanced prompt engineering and context engineering practices, such as system prompt design, structured outputs, few\-shot examples, prompt chaining, and prompt versioning, to produce reliable, accurate, and cost\-effective model behavior. * Maps business processes and designs, builds, and maintains workflow automations using workflow orchestration platforms, with a strong preference for n8n, integrating AI agents with enterprise systems, APIs, and data sources. * Establishes evaluation, testing, and observability practices for AI systems, including evaluation suites, regression testing of prompts and agents, guardrails, tracing, and monitoring of output quality, latency, and token cost. * Participates in code reviews, including review of prompts, agent co  in Management Information Systems, Computer Science, or related discipline; or the equivalent years of relevant business and technical experience. * A minimum of 8 to 10 years of experience in application software development and implementation, including hands\-on experience building solutions with large language models (LLMs), generative AI, and AI tooling. * Strong proficiency in Python, Rust, GoLang, and Node.js/TypeScript, with working knowledge of Java and the JVM ecosystem, and the judgment to choose the appropriate language for a given workload. * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs and SDKs (such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or AWS Bedrock) and agent frameworks (such as LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or comparable tooling). * Demonstrated expertise in prompt engineering and agentic engineering, including tool use, MCP, RAG, structured outputs, and techniques for reducing hallucination and improving reliability. * Experience mapping business workflows and building automations in n8n (preferred) or comparable workflow and orchestration platforms such as Make, Zapier, Temporal, or Apache Airflow. * Experience developing applications using Docker, AWS EC2, ECS/Fargate and Apache Kafka. * Experience with vector databases and embedding stores (such as pgvector, OpenSearch, or Pinecone). * Experience using standard interface/integration architecture and techniques (REST, webhooks, event\-driven architecture, APIs, Microservices, SOA, SOAP/WSDL/XML, SAML). * Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to explain AI capabilities and limitations to non\-technical stakeholders. * History of working in an Agile software development environment. * “Get stuff done” and flexible mindset for the greater good of the organization. * Proven success delivering high\-quality solutions on time. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, including engineers, product managers, and leadership. * Proven ability to collaborate effectively within a cross\-functional team, while also influencing technical direction and decision\-making within the team. * Demonstrates initiative and autonomy in identifying opportunities for improvement, driving solutions, and following through to execution. * Open to feedback and skilled at delivering constructive feedback to peers in a way that promotes growth, learning, and team cohesion. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and resolve complex technical challenges. * Consistently demonstrates ownership and accountability for delivering high\-quality, maintainable, and scalable solutions. * Actively mentors junior and mid\-level engineers, fostering a culture of inclusion, learning, and continuous improvement. * Comfortable stepping into informal leadership roles, such as guiding technical discussions or coordinating efforts on team\-level initiatives. **AI Engineer – Preferred Qualifications****:** * Healthcare knowledge or experience preferred. * Experience self\-hosting and administering n8n, including developing custom nodes and integrating n8n with AI agents and LLM services. * Experience building and evaluating RAG systems, embeddings, and model evaluation pipelines; familiarity with fine\-tuning is a plus. * Knowledge of AI security and safety practices, including guardrails, prompt injection mitigation, and responsible AI principles. * Experience working in an AWS or cloud\-based environment, including managed AI services such as AWS Bedrock. * Integration of rules engines with AI\-driven workflows. * Planning, developing, and deploying high\-volume, mission\-critical AI and software applications in a healthcare environment. * Knowledge or experience with HIPAA regulations and standards for security (PHI, IIHI), privacy, and transactions, particularly as they apply to the use of PHI with AI models and third\-party AI vendors.

jobs.description: **Senior Full\-Stack Engineer / Technical Lead** **LOCATION** **Hybrid · Orlando, FL** **SALARY** **$110K – $160K** **REPORTS TO** **Founder \& CEO** **RELOCATION** **Expenses Covered** JOB SUMMARY BidBuddy is a software platform that helps property managers manage requests for proposals, communicate with vendors, receive bids, and compare proposals using AI\-assisted tools. We are bringing software development in\-house after working with an external development firm. We are seeking an experienced, hands\-on engineer to take technical ownership of the existing platform and lead its continued development. This role combines full\-stack development, AWS infrastructure management, and practical technical leadership. You will work directly with the founder to understand customer needs, prioritize improvements, and deliver reliable features. **This is a hands\-on development role—not a management\-only position.** We need someone comfortable working independently across an existing codebase, investigating problems, making sound technical decisions, and owning features from planning through production. DUTIES ▪ Lead a structured technical handoff from our current development partner, including the codebase, architecture, cloud infrastructure, deployment processes, integrations, and outstanding work. ▪ Take ownership of the existing application, improving it incrementally rather than assuming it requires a complete rewrite. ▪ Develop and maintain frontend features using React and TypeScript, and backend services using Node.js, TypeScript, and AWS Lambda. ▪ Improve workflows for property managers and vendors, including RFP creation, vendor invitations, bid submissions, document handling, proposal comparisons, and messaging. ▪ Develop and maintain APIs, data models, authentication, and role\-based access controls. ▪ Maintain AWS infrastructure, including DynamoDB, S3, Cognito, and serverless services, using AWS CDK. ▪ Improve AI\-assisted document and bid\-analysis workflows, with attention to accuracy, source evidence, processing costs, and failure handling. ▪ Maintain automated deployments through GitHub Actions and strengthen testing, code review, and release practices. ▪ Monitor application reliability, troubleshoot production issues, and manage cloud and third\-party service costs. ▪ Protect confidential customer and vendor information through appropriate permissions, secure development practices, and careful data handling. ▪ Translate business requirements into clear implementation plans, communicate tradeoffs, and provide realistic delivery estimates. ▪ Document the system so the company retains technical knowledge and can onboard additional engineers as it grows. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS ▪ Substantial professional experience developing and maintaining production web applications. ▪ Strong proficiency in TypeScript, React, and Node.js. ▪ Hands\-on experience building, deploying, and supporting applications on AWS, particularly serverless architectures. ▪ Experience with APIs, authentication, authorization, and database design. ▪ Experience with DynamoDB or comparable NoSQL databases. ▪ Familiarity with infrastructure as code, automated deployment pipelines, Git, and automated testing. ▪ Demonstrated ability to understand and improve an existing application developed by another team. ▪ Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and explain technical decisions clearly to a business\-focused founder. ▪ A practical approach to balancing development speed, reliability, security, and cost. ▪ Willingness to write and maintain code as the primary technical owner. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS ▪ Experience taking over an application from an agency, consulting firm, or previous engineering team. ▪ Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS platforms serving different user roles. ▪ Experience integrating LLMs into production applications, including structured outputs, evidence validation, evaluation, and usage\-cost management. ▪ Experience with PDF processing, document extraction, or comparison workflows. ▪ Familiarity with Material UI, TanStack Query, Hono, Zod, OpenAI, LangChain, or Ably. ▪ Experience in property management, construction, procurement, or vendor\-management software. ▪ Experience establishing engineering practices for a small company and helping hire or mentor additional developers. jobs.description: Description: **About Atom Security** Atom Security LLC is a specialized cybersecurity brand purpose\-built on the foundation of Proven IT, a trusted managed services provider with a proven track record of delivering technology solutions to clients across the Midwest. Built to extend Proven IT’s continued success into a dedicated security practice, Atom Security delivers exceptional Managed Security Services (MSSP), professional security consulting, and fractional Chief Information Security Officer (vCISO) services to organizations that require specialized expertise beyond the scope of a generalist technology provider. Atom Security’s launch focus is the Defense Industrial Base (DIB), serving defense contractors pursuing CMMC Level 2 certification through a purpose\-built Microsoft GCC High sovereign platform. In parallel, Atom’s commercial practice serves clients in regulated industries including healthcare, finance, and manufacturing. This is a ground\-floor opportunity to help build and define a specialized security brand from inception, with direct impact on the architecture, culture, and client experience of a growing practice. **About This Role** This role owns end\-to\-end engineering delivery of Atom Security’s GCC High and Azure Commercial operations infrastructure — from tenant provisioning through security toolchain deployment and legacy tool migration — against an active, near\-term go\-live target. The platform supports a dual\-track service model: a Microsoft GCC High sovereign track for CMMC\-scoped DIB clients, and an Azure Commercial track for the broader managed security practice. This is a build role with a clear growth trajectory. The initial phase is a structured engineering sprint with defined deliverables and milestones. As the platform becomes operational and Atom Security scales, this position is designed to flex based on organizational needs and individual strengths — evolving toward either deep infrastructure ownership and ongoing platform administration, or toward client\-facing technical roles including vCISO support, client onboarding, and technical advisory engagements with DIB and commercial clients. The right candidate will have both the technical depth to build the platform and the professional presence to engage with clients as the practice grows. Candidates must have hands\-on experience provisioning and administering Microsoft GCC High environments. Azure Commercial experience alone is insufficient — the build schedule has no capacity to absorb a GCC High learning curve. **Key Responsibilities** ***Infrastructure Build*** * Provision Atom’s GCC High Operations Tenant through an AOS\-G authorized partner and build the parallel Azure Commercial Operations Tenant as isolated sovereign tracks * Establish Entra ID baseline across both tenants: admin account structure, security group naming conventions, and identity governance configuration * Deploy Azure Virtual Desktop host pool in Azure Government for SOC analyst and vCISO secure access * Configure Microsoft Lighthouse delegation framework across both tracks to support multi\-client MSSP management * Implement FIDO2/phish\-resistant MFA and Conditional Access policies across all administrative accounts on both tenants ***Identity and Access Governance*** * Configure Privileged Identity Management (PIM) for all privileged roles across both tenants * Enroll all analyst devices, vCISO devices, and AVD session hosts into GCC High and Commercial Intune respectively * Document the separate Entra identity model (distinct UPNs per track) as a formal access control artifact ***Security Toolchain Deployment*** * Stand up Microsoft Sentinel MSSP workspaces on both tracks with baseline analytics rules, alert routing, and cross\-workspace KQL queries * Apply Defender XDR P2 baseline policy across the GCC High tenant * Deploy CrowdStrike Gov endpoint agents to CMMC client environments; deploy CrowdStrike Commercial Falcon for non\-CMMC clients * Activate Azure Arc and Intune management on Atom operations devices * Verify track separation end\-to\-end and reflect findings in finalized network diagrams ***Legacy Tool Migration*** * Build SharePoint GCC High site structure to receive runbooks, SOPs, and client documentation migrated from legacy documentation platforms * Configure Azure DevOps Boards (GCC High) as the ticketing and work management replacement * Provision Azure Key Vault and execute controlled credential migration with documented access policy review * Update Atom’s System Security Plan (SSP) to remove transitional tool entries upon retirement confirmation ***Go\-Live and Growth*** * Support compliance documentation sprints — provide infrastructure evidence artifacts for SSP completion * Conduct end\-to\-end Lighthouse delegation testing for both anchor clients prior to go\-live * Complete final infrastructure verification pass against the go\-live readiness checklist * Support onboarding of client accounts to the Atom service omputer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment. * Ability to work on occasion to respond to security incidents outside normal business hours. * Primarily an office environment; occasional travel to client sites may be required. * Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. * Valid driver’s license and reliable form of transportation. **BENEFITS** **GROUP HEALTH INSURANCE:** After a 30\-day waiting period, full\-time employees (who work at least 30 hours per week) and their dependents, are eligible to enroll in health benefits through BlueCross BlueShield of Illinois (BCBSIL). Health options include a choice of 2 PPO plans, a High Deductible Health plan and an HMO. In addition, Dental benefits are available as well as a Vision PPO plan utilizing the EyeMed network. Atom Cyber Security also offers voluntary worksite benefits including critical illness and accident coverage, short\-term disability insurance, supplemental life and pet insurance. **EMPLOYER PROVIDED LIFE/AD\&D INSURANCE:** After a 30\-day waiting period, Atom Cyber Security provides a flat $25,000 Life Insurance benefit, administered by Mutual of Omaha, to all full\-time employees (who work at least 30 hours per week). Accidental Death \& Dismemberment (AD\&D) benefit payments are determined based on the type of loss incurred and are payable up to the full Life Insurance benefit amount. Life and AD\&D Insurance coverage amounts are reduced at ages 65, 70 and 75\. **EMPLOYER PROVIDED LTD:** Long\-Term Disability (LTD) insurance is an employer\-provided benefit and provides protection from loss of income in the event that an employee is unable to work due to illness, injury, or accident for a long period of time. jobs.title: Senior Optomechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **Location:** Onsite — Austin, TX **Employment Type:** Direct Hire, Full\-Time **Job Title:** Senior Optomechanical Engineer **About 9 Mothers** The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"—we are building the shield. Backed by top\-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real\-time. Our flagship product is a low\-power, counter\-drone system built for the edge—on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack. **Why 9 Mothers?** While others build for "awareness" or "long\-term research," we build for the immediate survival of those in harm’s way. We are a team of hackers, engineers, and mission\-driven builders who value field\-ready capability over polished slide decks. If you want to see your code or hardware in the field next month—not next year—this is your playground. **Position Summary** * We are hiring a Senior Optomechanical Engineer to own the optics\-related subsystems on our robotic weapon platforms: the cameras, thermal imagers, rangefinders, and sensor heads that let our systems find and engage small drones, and the windows, housings, and mounts that keep them working. This role exists because our optics have to hold alignment and image quality on a machine that fires shotguns, slews hard, and lives outdoors in Texas heat, dust, and rain. * This is not an optical design role. Our lens trains are designed by others, inside and outside the company. Your job is everything that happens to those optics once they leave the designer: how they are held, aligned, sealed, kept clean and dry, protected from shock and vibration, and made to perform the same at 0 °F as they do at 140 °F. You are the person who makes sure we get every bit of performance the optical designer put on paper, and you are the person who tells the designer early when a prescription will not survive the mount it needs. * The person we want thinks in degrees of freedom. You know where an optic is constrained and where it is free to move, how much it will move with temperature and load, and what that does to focus, boresight, and MTF. You have strong opinions on bonded versus clamped versus flexure mounts, and the experience to back them. You know what Invar, titanium, and stainless buy you over aluminum, and you know when aluminum is the right answer because the error budget allows it and the price does not. * This is a hands\-on role. You will build and align your own assemblies, put them on the shaker and in the thermal chamber, take them to the range, and measure what moved. **Essential Duties** * **Own the optical subsystems.** Be the responsible engineer for every sensor head, camera module, and optical window on the platform, from concept and requirements through production and field support. Own the optomechanical error budget and the drawings, ICDs, and test procedures that go with it. * **Mount optics properly.** Design kinematic, semi\-kinematic, flexure, bonded, and retained mounts for lenses, windows, mirrors, filters, and focal plane assemblies. Control preload, bond line thickness, and stress birefringence. Make mounts that can be aligned once and stay aligned. * **Choose materials on purpose.** Select housing, cell, spacer, and fastener materials to balance CTE match, stiffness, mass, machinability, corrosion, and cost. Run the athermalization math for focus and boresight, and make the cost\-versus\-stability call with numbers behind it. * **Manage shock and vibration.** Design for weapon recoil, gunfire shock, and gimbal slew loads. Drive structural modes away from excitation, specify or design isolation where it helps, and keep line\-of\-sight jitter and boresight shift within budget. Run modal and structural FEA and correlate it to test. * **Keep it clean and dry.** Design sealed, purged, and desiccated housings that keep moisture, dust, and contaminants off the glass for years in the field. Specify seals, breathers, purge and fill procedures, window coatings, and anti\-fog and window\-clearing approaches. Set up the clean assembly practices and handling procedures our technicians will follow. * **Align and boresight**. Develop alignment and co\-boresighting methods and fixtures for multiple sensors on a common mount and to the weapon. Make alignment repeatable on a production floor, not just on your bench. * **Work with the optical designers.** Turn lens prescriptions into buildable assemblies. Feed tolerance sensitivities and mechanical constraints back early. Support integrated structural\-thermal\-optical (STOP) analysis where it earns its keep. * **Test and prove it.** Plan and run thermal cycling, vibration, shock, humidity, and water\-ingress testing on optical assemblies. Measure what moved, in focus, boresight, and image quality, and close the loop into the next revision. * **Make it manufa  shock and vibration experience: modal analysis, random vibration and shock response, isolation, preload design, and the test methods to verify them (MIL\-STD\-810 or equivalent). You know the difference between a mount that passes the shaker and a mount that holds boresight after it. * Experience designing and building sealed optical housings: O\-ring and gasket design, dry nitrogen purge, desiccants, pressure equalization, window selection and mounting, and contamination control during assembly. * Fluency with optical tolerance and error budgets. You can read a lens prescription and drawing, understand which tolerances matter, and translate image\-quality and boresight requirements into mechanical requirements. * Proficiency in FEA (modal, structural, thermal) and the judgment to know when the model is wrong. * Strong GD\&T and drawing skills. Your drawings fully define an optical assembly and suppliers can build to them. * Hands\-on alignment and test skills: autocollimators, collimators, alignment telescopes, interferometry or MTF benches, and building your own fixtures when the right one does not exist. * A bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, optical engineering, or physics, or equivalent experience. * Efficient, low\-ego, and easy to work with. You say no clearly when a design will not survive, and you move work forward without drama. **Nice\-to\-Have** * Experience with weapon\-mounted or gun\-fire\-exposed optics: fire control sensors, weapon sights, remote weapon stations, or gimbaled EO/IR turrets. * Experience with infrared optics and windows (germanium, ZnS, ZnSe, chalcogenides, sapphire) and their mounting, coating, and thermal quirks. Experience integrating uncooled thermal cores. * Experience with laser rangefinders or other active optical systems, including transmit/receive boresight. * STOP analysis experience with tools such as Zemax OpticStudio, Code V, or Sigmadyne SigFit. * Experience with gimbal and stabilized\-platform design, where structural stiffness and line\-of\-sight stability drive the architecture. * Experience taking optical assemblies from prototype into rate production, including vendor qualification and production alignment fixtures. * An interest in firearms and the problems they create for everything bolted to them. * Experience in a venture\-backed hardware startup. **Benefits** * **Meaningful Early Equity:** You aren't just an employee; you are a foundational owner. Your contributions directly drive the value of your stake in the company. * **Direct Roadmap Influence:** Forget the bureaucracy of big defense. You will have a seat at the table, directly shaping our product and technology trajectory from day one. * **Mission\-Critical Work:** We don't build for "what if." We build systems the Department of War actively needs to counter immediate, real\-world threats. * **The Builder's Playground:** Work in a brand\-new lab fully optimized for rapid prototyping, equipped with NVIDIA Jetsons, high\-end scopes, and 3\-D printers. * **100% Employer\-Paid Premiums:** We cover 100% of your medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums and cover 50% of healthcare premiums for your dependents. * **Unlimited PTO:** We value results, not clock\-watching. Take the time you need to stay sharp and recharge. * **Zero Red Tape:** You have the autonomy to make technical decisions that would take months of committee approval at a larger firm. * **Austin\-Based Culture:** Join an onsite team in Austin, TX, where we prioritize high\-bandwidth collaboration and rapid field\-testing. * **Relocation Assistance:** We want the best talent in the room. If you aren't in Austin yet, we’ll help you get here, to make your transition to the Silicon Hills seamless. **About the Interview** * Initial screen with recruiter (30 min phone call) * Virtual interview with Director of Hardware Operations (30 min via MS Teams) * Onsite interview at our Austin facility (1 hour in\-person) Compensation Range: $160K \- $190K

jobs.title: Strategic AI Partnerships Lead
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ FlowGen Labs is a frontier enterprise AI company building the zero\-touch enterprise: context\-aware agents that operate inside highly customized SAP environments at machine speed, grounded in each company’s ontology, live operational data, and operating procedures so complex workflows can run autonomously instead of relying on manual support teams. FlowGen is focused on turning legacy ERP from a system of record into an execution layer for finance and operations. Deployed at Fortune 500 companies across CPG, distribution, high\-tech, and oil and gas, FlowGen Labs brings together a frontier AI and SAP team from DeepMind, SAP, Meta AI, and Amazon AGI Labs. **Role Summary** ---------------- We’re hiring a Strategic AI Partnerships Lead to build and grow FlowGen’s most important enterprise relationships, from the first conversation through signed contracts, successful deployments, and expansion. You’ll combine the commercial ownership of an enterprise account executive, the judgment of an AI strategist, and the execution of an engagement leader. You will identify new customers, build executive trust, develop a compelling business case, and close strategic deals. You will then stay accountable for making sure the customer gets what was sold: a well\-scoped deployment, strong adoption, and measurable business impact. Working closely with the founders, Forward Deployed Engineers, and product team, you’ll turn complex finance and operations problems into AI programs that customers trust and use. This is a hands\-on role for someone who can move comfortably between a boardroom, a commercial negotiation, and a working session with the people running the process. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts end to end, with accountability for new revenue, successful delivery, customer outcomes, retention, and expansion. * Generate net\-new opportunities through targeted account research, direct outreach, executive relationships, referrals, and industry events. Build a repeatable pipeline of enterprises where FlowGen can create material value. * Develop strategic partnerships with relevant technology providers, systems integrators, and industry networks to open doors, shape joint opportunities, and bring FlowGen into new accounts. * Lead discovery with finance, operations, and technology teams. Understand process steps, exceptions, controls, data sources, and manual workarounds; prioritize AI workflows based on business value, technical feasibility, and organizational readiness. * Run the full sales cycle from qualification and solution development through proposals, pricing, procurement, security review, negotiation, and close. Build executive sponsorship and business cases for six\-figure and above ACV deals. * Align customers and internal teams on scope, success metrics, milestones, resources, and acceptance criteria before commitments are made. Work with engineering to ensure the solution is feasible and the delivery plan supports what was sold. * Lead the customer engagement through implementation and production adoption. Coordinate Forward Deployed Engineers, AI strategists, product teams, and customer stakeholders; manage dependencies, risks, scope changes, and executive communication. * Stay accountable until the deployment delivers measurable results. Track outcomes such as cycle\-time reduction, touchless processing, error reduction, working\-capital improvement, and support\-cost reduction, and drive action when results fall short. * Build durable relationships with executives and frontline users. Lead business reviews, resolve escalations, and turn successful deployments into renewals, references, and expansion across workflows and business units. * Maintain clear account plans, accurate forecasts, and disciplined CRM records. Partner with the founders to refine our positioning, sales and delivery playbooks, and feed customer insights into the product roadmap. **Who You Are** --------------- * 7\+ years in enterprise software sales, strategic partnerships, management consulting, or enterprise transformation, with demonstrated ownership of both commercial growth and customer delivery. * A track record of originating and winning new enterprise business. You can point to deals you personally helped source, shape, negotiate, and close, and explain the outcomes delivered afterward. * Experience leading complex customer engagements with multiple business and technical stakeholders, ideally at Fortune 500 or Global 2000 companies. * Strong executive presence and analytical judgment. You can translate an ambiguous operational problem into a quantified business case and an executable deployment plan. * Practical fluency with AI, automation, and enterprise software. You can discuss agentic workflows, integrations, data readiness, reliability, and human oversight with technical teams and explain the business implications clearly. * A disciplined operator who can manage parallel workstreams, surface risks early, hold owners accountable, and earn customer trust through consistent follow\-through. * Comfortable in an early\-stage environment, working directly on opportunities while building the processes and team practices that help us scale. * Familiarity with SAP, ERP, finance operations, supply chain, procurement, or order management is a plus. Curiosity and the ability to develop deep domain expertise matter. **Why Join** ------------ * Own visible, measurable outcomes at some of the world’s largest enterprises, from winning the relationship to delivering the impact. * Work at the intersection of frontier AI, enterprise operations, and deeply customized SAP environments. * Partner directly with founders and an unusually strong team from DeepMind, SAP, Meta AI, and Amazon AGI Labs. * Shape FlowGen’s revenue, product direction, deployment methodology, and customer strategy at an early stage. * A high bar for velocity, ownership, customer trust, and pragmatic execution. **Compensation** ---------------- $300K–$450K annual on\-target earnings (OTE), comprising base salary and performance\-based variable compensation, plus equity. **Logistics** ------------- * Location: Hybrid (located in the US) * Travel: Regular customer travel across the US and Europe, as required by the engagement * Visa support and sponsorship available Compensation Range: $300K \- $450K

jobs.title: Strategy Manager, Office of the CEO
jobs.description: **Team:** Office of the CEO **Reports to:** Founder \& CEO **Location:** Sawtelle, Los Angeles, CA (onsite, five days per week) **Employment type:** Full\-time, salaried, exempt **Base salary:** $150,000 to $180,000, plus equity Plug's Founder \& CEO needs someone who can take the company's most important open questions (where to grow, what the numbers are really saying, whether an opportunity is worth pursuing) and come back with the analysis, a recommendation, and a plan to execute it. This is an analytical role first. It is not an administrative Chief of Staff, EA, or PMO role. **About Plug** -------------- Plug is an automotive fintech startup building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Consumers, dealers, and commercial partners trade in, sell, and auction used EVs through a platform built exclusively for electric, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. Consumers get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data\-driven pricing and battery state\-of\-health analysis, with pickup, payment, and title transfer handled end to end. Franchise and independent dealers across the United States bid in real time on inventory sourced directly from consumers, dealers, and commercial partners. The result is a single platform that gives sellers a fast, fair exit and gives dealers a dedicated channel for sourcing used EV inventory. Founded in 2023 and led by former Tesla executives, Plug has facilitated $150M in EV sales since launch and is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners. We're building the most AI\-native startup team in Los Angeles: operators, engineers, and ML researchers laying the transaction rails for the used EV market's exponential growth. **Why this role** ----------------- As Plug grows, the number of priorities competing for the CEO's attention is growing with it. Many of the most important ones don't sit neatly inside one function: a marketplace economics question, a new market to evaluate, a board discussion that needs a sharper answer, a strategic tradeoff with incomplete data. You'll own that work. You'll take a loosely defined problem, structure it, get to the data, form a point of view, and drive it to a decision and then to execution. You'll work directly with the Founder \& CEO and across Plug's leadership team. **Your mission** ---------------- Take important, ambiguous problems off the CEO's plate and come back with a better answer than he'd have gotten by doing the work himself. Then make sure it gets done. **What you will own** --------------------- **Business analysis and recommendations.** Own the CEO's hardest analytical questions: marketplace liquidity, unit economics, pricing, growth, and customer behavior. Form hypotheses, pull and pressure\-test the data yourself, and land on a recommendation with clear tradeoffs. **CEO strategic projects.** Lead high\-priority, cross\-functional projects end to end. Define the problem, structure the work, drive to a decision, and hand off or execute. **New opportunities and business cases.** Size markets and evaluate new products, segments, and partnerships. Build the model and the business case, and tell the CEO whether it's worth pursuing and why. **Market and competitive intelligence.** Track EV, automotive retail, and fintech dynamics and competitors. Distill them into implications for Plug, not summaries. **Board, investor, and fundraising materials.** Own the analysis and narrative behind board decks, investor updates, and fundraising materials. Gather inputs across the company and turn them into a clear, defensible story. **AI\-native execution.** Use AI aggressively for research, analysis, synthesis, drafting, and workflow automation. We're looking for someone who naturally asks, "How can I do this faster and better?" before adding process or headcount. **Driving CEO priorities to completion.** Once a decision is made, make sure it happens. Turn CEO and leadership\-team decisions into clear owners and next steps, and keep the handful of priorities that matter most moving. The subject matter will change as the company grows. **Continuous improvement.** Look for friction in how we make decisions and get work done. Identify what's slow, manual, repetitive, or no longer serving us, and fix it with data, AI, automation, or simply a better way of working. Don't preserve a process because "that's how we've always done it." **What success looks like after 12 months** ------------------------------------------- * You've led several CEO\-sponsored projects from question to decision to execution, and at least one has materially changed a Plug decision on pricing, market entry, or resource allocation. * The CEO hands you ambiguous questions without a detailed brief and trusts what comes back. * You own the analytical backbone of board and investor materials. The CEO edits; he doesn't draft. * You've surfaced at least one problem or opportunity nobody asked you to look at. * You've replaced at least one slow, manual wo cise memo or a clear CEO\- or board\-level presentation. * **Strong Excel modeling skills.** * **High ownership.** You don't wait for someone to give you every step. * **Constructive challenge.** You're comfortable working directly with senior executives and pushing back when the data says something different. * **Follow\-through.** You'll do the unglamorous work required to get something across the finish line. * **Real AI usage.** You can point to specific ways AI has changed how you research, model, or write, not just that you use it. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience at an early\-stage or high\-growth technology company * Marketplace, automotive, fintech, mobility, or consumer technology experience * Experience preparing board, investor, or fundraising materials * Market sizing and competitive analysis * SQL **How we operate** ------------------ We hire builders who value ownership, velocity, curiosity, and measurable outcomes. We move quickly, decide with data, and treat AI as a core operating principle. The people who do well here scope their own work, run their own process, and keep several workstreams moving without being managed closely. They're comfortable with complexity and ambiguity and can take a partly defined problem and come back with a plan. This role tracks the CEO's pace. Expect frequent evening and weekend work, particularly around board meetings, fundraising, and high\-priority projects. **High agency. Low ego. Bias for action.** **Why Plug** ------------ * You'll work directly with the Founder \& CEO on the company's highest\-priority problems: strategy, board discussions, investors, new opportunities, and marketplace economics. * You'll get exposure across the business rather than sitting inside one function. * You'll have real ownership and a direct line to company outcomes. * You'll work alongside operators who have scaled multi\-billion\-dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces. * You'll be part of an AI\-native company that's rethinking how work gets done. **Not sure you should apply? Do it.** ------------------------------------- Research consistently shows that people from under\-represented groups are more likely to talk themselves out of applying if they don't meet 100% of the listed requirements. You don't need to check every box. If this role excites you and you bring most of what's listed under "What we need from you," we want to hear from you. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- **Base salary:** $150,000 to $180,000, plus equity Salary ranges reflect independent, third\-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an individual's offer falls within the range depends on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, business needs, and market conditions. Ranges are reviewed periodically and may be adjusted. * Health, vision, and dental insurance * 401(k) plan * Daily lunch and dinner stipend * Equity * Unlimited PTO * Fully stocked kitchen * Dog\-friendly office * On\-site EV charging This full\-time position is based in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles) and is in person five days per week. We welcome candidates from all locations who are willing to relocate; relocation assistance is available. Visa sponsorship is not available at this time. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Plug is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, marital status, military or veteran status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe diverse teams build better products. Plug will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring and the California Fair Chance Act. Compensation Range: $150K \- $180K

jobs.description: Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first. We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast\-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together. The Principal, Data Governance Platforms is the organization's technical authority for enabling enterprise data governance through purpose\-built technology platforms and data management capabilities, spanning metadata, master data, data quality, and lineage. Working at the intersection of data engineering, enterprise architecture, and governance strategy, this role ensures that governance is not just a policy — it is a platform capability that operates reliably at scale. Collaborating closely with data engineering teams, enterprise architects, and governance operations counterparts, the Principal designs and implements the technical infrastructure that makes governance measurable, auditable, and sustainably automated.**JOB DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES** **1\. Governance Platform Strategy \& Architecture** Define the technology architecture for enterprise data governance capabilities — including metadata management, MDM, data quality, and lineage — ensuring the platform strategy supports both current operational requirements and future AI and analytics ambitions. Align platform decisions with enterprise data architecture principles and cloud ecosystem standards. **2\. Platform Implementation \& Lifecycle Operations** Lead and execute the implementation of governance platforms, managing configuration, integration, testing, and go\-live activities in partnership with engineering and IT teams. Ensure platforms operate at production\-grade standards for performance, availability, and data integrity across all governance use cases. **3\. Data Lifecycle Capability Enablement** Enable governance\-aligned data integration, transformation, enrichment, and standardization capabilities by embedding governance controls directly into data pipelines and processing workflows. Partner with data engineering to ensure governance requirements are built into platform architecture from the ground up, not layered on afterward. **4\. Data Integration \& Workflow Automation** Design and implement automated governance workflows — including data quality rule execution, metadata harvesting, lineage capture, and MDM matching — within data pipelines and platform ecosystems. Reduce manual governance overhead by embedding automation at the point of data creation and movement. **5\. Lineage, Observability \& Traceability** Enable comprehensive visibility into data flows, system dependencies, and transformation logic to support impact analysis, audit readiness, and root cause investigation. Maintain lineage capabilities that span the full data ecosystem from source systems through to downstream consumption in analytics, reporting, and AI model inputs. **6\. Technical Governance Standards \& Documentation** Establish and maintain technical standards for how governance platforms are configured, integrated, and operated, ensuring consistency across platform implementations and enabling knowledge transfer to engineering teams. jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (Laravel, Node.js)
jobs.description: **On\-site in Gurnee, IL. You must already live within commuting distance.** This role is based in our office at 1800 Nations Drive in Gurnee, Illinois, about four days a week, with flexible work\-from\-home when you need it. You must already live within commuting distance: Lake County, the north Chicago suburbs or the Kenosha area. All interviews are in person. We cannot consider remote\-only applicants, and we do not sponsor visas. **Pay:** $75,000 to $100,000 per year, full\-time **Benefits:** health insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid time off and holidays, company\-paid AI development tools and training, flexible schedule **Build the engine behind websites that sell hypercars.** All Auto Network designs, builds and markets websites for exotic, luxury and classic car dealers selling Ferrari, Lamborghini, McLaren, Rolls\-Royce, Aston Martin, Rimac, Zenvo and Spyker, and more. We work with hundreds of dealerships, including some of the largest exotic dealer groups in the country. Clients see the websites. Underneath is a platform we built ourselves: * inventory feeds that move thousands of vehicles and photos every day and syndicate them to third\-party marketplaces * lead routing into dealer CRMs, including location\-aware routing for multi\-location dealer groups * vehicle\-acquisition programs that help dealers buy cars directly from the public * integrations with dozens of automotive vendors * the internal admin, billing and reporting tools our whole company runs on On our sites, a vehicle page is never just a page. It's wired to live inventory data, photos, search rankings, ad campaigns, lead routing and the dealer's CRM. That's the system you'll own. And there's always something custom on the bench. Recent examples: * a specialty auction platform * an acquisition program expanding from classic cars into exotics, motorcycles and boats * an outside website moving onto our platform without losing the search rankings it has earned **What makes this role different** We're not hiring someone to close tickets on one slice of a giant codebase. We want a builder. You'll design new systems, keep proven ones running, and decide where the platform goes next. Most developers only get to do one of those. Here you'll do all three. You'll own real production systems from start to finish: architect, build, test, ship and support. The people who depend on your work are down the hall in support, accounting, operations and project management. When you ship a tool on Tuesday, you'll watch someone use it Wednesday morning. **Keep it running. Make it better. Decide what's next.** Our stack is Laravel and PHP at the core, Node.js services alongside it, React and Next.js for a growing set of tools and front ends, MySQL, and Linux. Some of that PHP has been running dealer sites reliably for years. Running a platform like that well means three things: * **Keep it running.** Understand why the existing code works before you change it, and keep it reliable for the people who depend on it every day. * **Make it better.** Spot where it's holding the business back, and fix it in deliberate steps. Don't rewrite things just to follow a trend, and don't let anything rot. * **Decide what's next.** Turn what you learn into upgrade plans covering the approach, the tradeoffs, the risks and the rollout. Then present them to leadership and lead the work once they're approved. Your voice will shape our architecture. Senior leadership and our systems administrator are your partners on infrastructure and the biggest bets. Bring them a well\-reasoned plan and they'll back you. **What you'll own** * The design and build of new systems, services and integrations, from first sketch to production * Our in\-house Laravel and PHP applications: admin tools, reports, billing workflows and dealer back offices * Node.js services and tools, plus front ends built in React, Next.js and whatever framework fits the job best * Inventory feeds that import, normalize and distribute vehicle data and images over XML, JSON, CSV, FTP/SFTP and APIs * Lead forms, CRM delivery, spam protection and role\-based access * MySQL schema design, migrations, data quality and query performance * Production health on Linux: logs, processes, workers and service status * Safe releases: staging, deployment, monitoring and rollback * The modernization roadmap: what to upgrade, in what order, and why * Daily work in Claude Code and Cursor (we pay for them), with every change reviewed and tested before it ships **A week in the role** * **Monday:** a dealer's inventory feed starts sending malformed data. You trace it from the vendor's file through parsing and into the database, and the cars are back on the site by lunch. * **Tuesday:** a price\-history job takes over a minute to run. You rework the queries and get it down to a couple of seconds. * **Wednesday:** you sketch the architecture for a new multi\-location inventory feature. You weigh the data model, how it touches exi lan you won't need. **Where it leads** We're a small company that does big things, and we don't pigeonhole people. Your influence over the platform grows as fast as your judgment proves out. Developers here have grown into technical leadership, systems administration, data and automation, and marketing technology. You choose the direction, and our senior team helps you get there. **What you bring** * 4\+ years of full stack development, with deep PHP at the core, including serious work in mature code you didn't write * **Proof that you can build systems, not just features.** You've designed something real and shipped it, and you've lived with your decisions in production. * **Sound judgment across tradeoffs.** Before choosing an approach, you weigh performance, reliability, cost, security, maintainability and the people who'll use it. * **The ability to sell a plan.** You can explain a technical direction to non\-technical leadership in plain terms, with its risks and payoff. * Strong Laravel: architecture, queues and workers, console commands, migrations, configuration and deployments * Modern JavaScript: real Node.js experience, React or Next.js on the front end, and the range to pick up whatever framework a project calls for * Strong MySQL, including schema design and performance tuning * API and data\-integration experience: JSON, XML, CSV, FTP/SFTP, webhooks and scheduled imports * Comfort on the Linux command line, plus disciplined habits around version control, staging, backups and rollback **Bonus points** * You've led a legacy modernization or platform migration from plan to finish * Inventory, e\-commerce, CRM or data\-feed experience * Building internal admin, reporting or operations tools * Adding automated tests to systems that relied on manual testing * Daily AI\-assisted development, with the judgment to spot when the output is wrong You don't need to know cars. We'll teach you the automotive side. **How we work** * Practical over flashy. We want technology that's useful and understandable to the people who rely on it, not technology for its own sake. * We don't hand clients a template and walk away. We build, listen and refine until it actually fits how their business runs. * A small team doing big work, with no layers of bureaucracy. Designers, developers, systems, marketing and support all work on the same problems, and good work gets noticed. * On\-site in Gurnee about four days a week, with flexible work\-from\-home when life calls for it. Beyond that, we care about ownership and results, not rigid hours. **How we hire** We want proof, not buzzwords. Our process shows us how you build, how you think, and how you'd make the case for a change. * **Phone call:** a short conversation about your experience and the systems you've built. * **Walkthrough, in person in Gurnee:** bring something you designed and built, and take us through the architecture, the decisions behind it, and what you'd do differently now. * **Practical exercise:** we hand you a small legacy system. Fix a real problem in it, then put together a short upgrade plan you'd pitch to leadership. AI tools are welcome. * **Meet the team:** talk with the people you'd work with every day. We move quickly and keep you updated along the way. When you apply, include a few sentences about a system you designed and built, and one key decision you made along the way. *All Auto Network is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate every candidate on job\-related skills, experience and potential, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected characteristic.* Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Employee mentoring program * Flexible schedule * Flextime * Health insurance * Paid holidays * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Work from home Ability to Commute: * Gurnee, IL 60031 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- What if the data you engineer could stop fraud before it happens \- and protect millions of AWS customers worldwide? The Payments and Fraud Data Platform team within AWS Payments \& Fraud is the backbone of one of the most critical missions at AWS: ensuring every transaction is safe, every suspension is justified, and every customer experience is seamless. We process petabytes of data daily, powering the ML models, rule engines, and real\-time reporting systems that allow us to detect bad actors. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer who is passionate about building large\-scale data systems, thrives in ambiguity, and wants to work at the intersection of big data, machine learning, non\-payment and fraud prevention. Key job responsibilities Architect \& Build Petabyte\-Scale Data Pipelines \- Design, develop, and optimize batch and near\-real\-time data pipelines using Amazon Managed Airflow (MWAA), Fargate, EMR, Apache Iceberg, and Amazon Redshift to ingest, transform, and serve data at massive scale. Power ML \& Rules Engines \- Deliver high\-quality, timely datasets that fuel non payment and fraud detection ML models and business rule engines, directly impacting fraud prevention and non\-payment suspension accuracy. Build Intelligent Data Access Layers \- Design and implement a Smart Query \& Data Access Analyzer that profiles query patterns, identifies hot data, and automatically promotes frequently accessed datasets into hot memory tiers (e.g., OpenSearch, DynamoDB DAX, Redshift RA3 caching) for sub\-second retrieval. Create Natural Language SQL Interfaces \- Leverage Amazon Bedrock and LLM (large language models) to build a natural language\-to\-SQL generation tool that empowers analysts and stakeholders to query complex fraud datasets conversationally \- no SQL expertise required. Develop Real\-Time Dashboards \& Insights \- Build rich, interactive dashboards using Grafana and internal tooling that provide real\-time visibility into fraud trends, pipeline health, data quality metrics, and operational KPIs. Curate a Living Data Dictionary \- Design and maintain a comprehensive, searchable data catalog and dictionary that provides rich metadata, lineage, and documentation \- improving discoverability and self\-service analytics across the organization. Champion Data Quality at Scale \- Implement automated data validation, anomaly detection, and reconciliation frameworks that ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency across the entire data lifecycle. Secure \& Govern Sensitive Data \- Implement encryption, fine\-grained access controls, audit trails, and compliance frameworks to protect highly sensitive payments and fraud data. Monitor, Optimize, Repeat \- Build observability into everything , proactive alerting, pipeline performance tracking, SLA monitoring, and intelligent auto\-remediation to ensure five\-nines data reliability. About the team The AWS Payments \& Fraud Prevention team protects AWS and its customers from fraud, abuse, and account compromise at global scale. We build highly scalable, batch and near real\-time systems that ingest billions of signals daily, process petabytes of data, and make timed decisions to stop bad actors from account registration through the entire customer lifecycle. Our platform is built on a modern, cloud\-native architecture designed for petabyte\-class batch processing. Our stack includes Amazon MWAA orchestrates workflows, while EMR and Fargate handle scalable data processing. Amazon Redshift powers our data warehouse, complemented by an Apache Iceberg lakehouse for open table format flexibility. DynamoDB and OpenSearch drives search and analytics, and Amazon Bedrock serves as our AI/ML foundation. Development is accelerated with Kiro, an AI\-powered IDE, and Grafana provides full\-stack observability. We are a team of builders who care deeply about customer trust and love solving complex problems at massive scale. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * 1\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience * 1\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience * 1\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field * Experience programming with at least one software programming language **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Rufus is a generative AI\-powered shopping assistant in the Amazon Shopping app designed to help answer a variety of shopping\-related questions. Rufus makes it easy for customers to find and discover the best products to meet their needs by helping with product research, providing comparisons and recommendations, answering specific product questions, and more. The Retrieval Engineering team is a critical component of the Rufus infrastructure, responsible for building and scaling the systems that power information retrieval, search relevance, and data access patterns that enable Rufus to deliver accurate, contextual responses to millions of customers worldwide. We are searching for a Senior Software Development Engineer who is passionate about technology, innovation, and customer experience to join the Retrieval Engineering team within Rufus. If you are thrilled about creating customer experiences that will be used by millions of people worldwide and are eager to tackle technical challenges that have never been addressed before, then this is the perfect opportunity for you. Key job responsibilities As a Senior Software Development Engineer in this role, you are a recognized technical leader who drives the engineering strategy, mentors team members, and partners with cross\-functional teams to deliver complex end\-to\-end retrieval solutions. Your work focuses on architecting and implementing robust systems in ambiguous problem areas where both the business problem and solution approach need to be defined. You will: * Lead the technical vision and innovation for retrieval systems that power AI\-driven shopping experiences on Amazon Rufus * Design and build scalable, high\-performance retrieval infrastructure that serves millions of customers with fast, reliable, and secure responses * Own features end\-to\-end, from conception through design, implementation, and production deployment * Collaborate with experienced cross\-disciplinary Amazonians including Applied Scientists, Software Engineers, and Product Managers to conceive, design, and bring innovative solutions * Improve latency, quality, and relevance metrics in partnership with science and engineering teams across Rufus * Build LLM\-based retrieval workflows and content generation pipelines * Partner with Applied Scientists to perform prompt tuning, retrieval evaluations, and relevance assessments * Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems, bringing deep expertise to provide context for current and future technology choices * Take ownership of the long\-term technical vision, product roadmaps, and technologies, defining how systems should evolve * Build consensus through thoughtful discussions with stakeholders, scientists, and engineering peers across multiple teams * Work in an agile environment to deliver high\-quality software with a focus on operational excellence * Mentor and grow junior developers, encourage software development best practices, and iterate quickly * Play an active role in building quick prototypes or proofs of concept in partnership with other technology leaders within the team * Tackle challenging, novel situations every day and have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon A day in the life The challenges Senior SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years. Along the way, you'll learn a lot, have fun, and make a positive impact on millions of people. About the team You will be an integral part of a passionate and creative team that encourages experimentation and innovation on behalf of our customers. Global from Day 1 is a bold new program within FBA making it possible for sellers to reach customers worldwide — not someday, but immediately. Multi\-country sellers earn 70% more revenue on average, yet only \~30% list in more than one country today. We're changing that. We are building a marketplace\-agnostic Global Inventory Pool at Amazon's scale — where sellers ship their product once and replenish seamlessly across all FBA regions worldwide. jobs.description: Join the team redefining what a deeply personal and integrated assistant can be. As part of the Siri organization, you will help shape one of the world’s most widely used AI assistants. It runs on our next generation of Apple Intelligence, with capabilities like personal context understanding and on\-screen awareness, and it is built with privacy from the ground up. We build the harness, the foundation that turns a model into an assistant that can act. This is a systems engineering role for people who understand how large language models behave. **Description** A model can't act on its own. The harness runs the agent loop, carries context and tools to the model, executes the tool calls it makes, and streams results back reliably. It spans models running on device and larger models in Private Cloud Compute. It handles everything from single\-turn requests to long multi\-step tasks that span apps, survive interruptions, and resume cleanly. We're looking for a strong systems engineer who is fluent in how LLMs behave. The work is real\-time and resource\-constrained: responses must start fast enough for a voice assistant to feel instant, under tight latency, memory, and power limits on everything from Mac and iPhone to Apple Watch. Failures rarely have a single cause. In a typical week you might track down why a streamed response stalls, make tool calls cancel cleanly when the user interrupts, or replay a failed request to tell whether the model, the context, or the runtime was at fault. Every change to the harness changes how the model behaves, so we measure our work with evals, not just tests. You'll join the team that owns the core runtime and work alongside senior engineers and researchers. You'll also partner closely with the modeling, tools, and context teams and with app and framework teams across Apple. You'll take features from design through production and grow your ownership of the system over time. Engineering based on quality, cost, security, and time to value * Shape the AI technical roadmap in partnership with Product and Architecture, helping prioritize work by business value, feasibility, retrieval, and inference * Partner with Data Engineering to define data contracts, feature se + years of software engineering experience, including 4\+ years building and deploying AI or machine learning solutions in production * Track record of leading and shipping multiple AI features used by real customers or operations teams, with measurable business outcomes * Strong programming skills in Python, along with experience in .NET/C\#/Java or a comparable enterprise language, including building backend services and REST APIs (for example FastAPI, Flask, or ASP.NET) * Hands\-on experience with large language models and generative AI patterns, including retrieval augmented generation, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, reranking, structured outputs, function and tool calling, context window management, and model evaluation * Experience designing and deploying production AI workloads on cloud\-based AI and machine learning platforms (AWS preferred, including services such as Amazon Bedrock and Amazon SageMaker; equivalent Azure experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, or Azure Machine Learning also acceptable) * Strong knowledge of APIs, requirements shape solution design * Demonstrated technical leadership across teams, including setting technical direction, driving architectural decisions, and mentoring other engineers * Ability to findings drive improvement of prompts, models, and guardrails * Establish the experimentation approach, including A/B testing across prompts, retrieval configurations, model selection, and workflow design * Define and enforce quality gates and regression thresholds so AI features must meet defined accuracy and safety criteria before release **Data Engineering \& Integration*** Set the technical direction for the pipelines that prepare structured and unstructured healthcare data, such as enrollment forms, payer documents, and clinical notes, for training, retrieval, and inference * Pa asurable business outcomes * Expert programming skills in Python, along with experience in .NET/C\#/Java or a comparable enterprise language, including building backend services and REST APIs (for example FastAPI, Flask, or ASP.NET) * Deep, hands\-on expertise with large language models and generative AI patterns, including retrieval augmented generation, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, reranking, structured outputs, function and tool calling, context window management, and model evaluation * Extensive experience architecting and operating production AI workloads on cloud\-based AI and machine learning platforms (AWS preferred, including services such as Amazon Bedrock and Amazon SageMaker; equivalent Azure experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, or Azure Machine Learning also acceptable) * Expert knowledge of APIs, microservices, distributed systems, SQL, and modern development practices including Git, CI/CD, containerization, and automated testing * Demonstrated ability to deliver in an environment where data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements shape solution design * Demonstrated enterprise\-level technical leadership, including setting technical strategy, driving architectural decisions across teams, and developing other technical leaders * Ability to work independently on highly ambiguous, high\-impact problems, set direction, and make sound tradeoffs with limited precedent * Hands\-on experience building software with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot agents, Codex, or jobs.description: Now As a result of the combination of the BD Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business with Waters Corporation (NYSE: WAT), by applying to this role, you will be applying for a position with Waters. Waters collaborates with analytical laboratories around the world to advance the release of effective, high\-quality medicines, assure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combatting growing antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, Waters’ passionate team of approximately 16,000 colleagues partner with customers to turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide. **We are the people who give possibilities purpose** ---------------------------------------------------- BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities. **Job Description** =================== **Summary:** We are seeking a Software Engineer to contribute to the design, development, testing, and support of software solutions for advanced medical diagnostic instrumentation. You will thrive in a team\-oriented culture, value continuous improvement, and be eager to grow your technical expertise while making meaningful contributions to innovative software development projects. **Responsibilities:** * Participate in the design, development, testing, and support of software components and subsystems. * Work with the team to establish software requirements, design specifications, and test plans for product verification and validation. * Translate requirements into well\-structured, maintainable, and documented software designs and implementations. * Implement new software functionality and enhancements to existing software products. * Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software defects within existing automation and diagnostic systems. * Develop and maintain automated unit tests to verify software functionality and reliability. * Participate in technical design reviews, code reviews, and software inspections. * Monitor progress of assigned work and with software engineers, test engineers, systems engineers, and subject matter experts throughout the software development lifecycle. * Adhere to software development processes, quality standards, and regulatory requirements. * Contribute to the delivery of high\-quality, reliable software for medical diagnostic instrumentation. **Minimum Required:** * Bachelor of Science degree in Computer object\-oriented programming through academic projects, internships, co\-op assignments, personal projects, or professional experience. * Experience developing software using a modern programming language such as C\#, C\+\+, Java, Python, or a similar object\-oriented language. * Has an understanding of software engineering fundamentals including object\-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, debugging, and unit testing. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Previous Internship, co\-op, research, or project experience involving software development. * Experience with one or more areas of our software stack, including: Desktop application development, Web\-based user interface development, REST/Web Services, Relational databases and SQL, Automated testing, Network communications, Embedded, automation, robotics, motion control, or process\-control systems. * Experience using source control systems such as Git. * Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development practices. Experience developing software in a regulated environment or for complex hardware/software systems. * **Why Join Us?** ================ To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive. We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face\-to\-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success. **To learn more about BD visit** https://bd.com/careers.
