jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- **This is a courtesy posting for the Iowa General Assembly. Applicants should follow instructions in "To Apply" to be considered.** Effective immediately, applications are being taken by the Legislative Services Agency for the position of Computer Systems Developer. Applicants should submit a resume and cover letter to the Director, Legislative Services Agency, State Capitol, Des Moines, Iowa 50319, online at https://www.legis.iowa.gov/careers. The Legislative Services Agency is an equal opportunity employer. Applications must be received by November 8, 2026\. The LSA is a nonpartisan, central staff agency of around 100 employees serving members and committees of the Iowa General Assembly. The LSA’s workforce spans three divisions and multiple offices where individuals contribute their unique expertise and talents to advance a shared mission of serving the Iowa General Assembly in a nonpartisan manner. The LSA offers meaningful work with great benefits. Our employees participate in the Iowa Public Employees’ Retirement System (IPERS) pension plan, the LSA is a qualifying employer for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program (PSLF), and low\-cost, high\-quality health and dental insurance is offered. The nonpartisan position will develop, create, modify, and maintain applications, databases, and webpages for the Iowa General Assembly. The position requires excellent analytical and communication skills, the ability to work as part of a team, the ability to interpret application specifications, the ability to detect and oversee the correction of problems with applications and databases, and the ability to analyze programming problems and develop satisfactory solutions. A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science or Information Services or a minimum four years of relevant work experience is required. Ability to handle heavy workload under extremely short deadlines and to prioritize workload is essential. This is an onsite position only. Overtime work is required with partial compensatory time provided. Beginning annual salary is $62,753\.60, or commensurate with experience. Partisan political activity and legislative issue advocacy are prohibited. **Qualifications, Skills, and Ability:** * Knowledge of computer programming techniques for one or more platforms. * Knowledge of Microsoft Windows Operating System and Microsoft SQL Server. * Knowledge of basic methods/tools used for application problem determination and resolution. * Knowledge of at least one programming language (JAVA, C\#.Net). * Ability to read and write the English language. * Ability to assume additional responsibilities and duties as assigned. * Ability to work as a team member in solving problems and improving service delivery. * Ability to provide quality work to a variety of clients and customers. * Ability to detect and oversee the correction of problems in assigned areas of responsibility. * Ability to follow oral and written instructions. * Ability to read and interpret technical manuals/publications. * Ability to logically analyze programming problems and develop satisfactory solutions. * Willingness to self\-motivate and show initiative related to workplace duties. * Willingness to learn basic knowledge of the legislative process and state government. **Duties:** * Develop, test, and maintain computer application programs for the Legislature. * Develop, test, and maintain databases for the Legislature. * Interpret program specifications and develop reports, templates, programming code, spreadsheets, etc.; test/prepare documentation to support the use of the applications. * Determine symptoms and causes related to process problems and resolve them. * Interpret program specifications and develop/modify structure diagrams, flow charts, and pseudo code to depict the logical flow of programs. * Develop code using language and tools outlined in program specifications and documents in programs. * Test programs and review results to detect and correct errors. * Display a high level of initiative, effort, attention to detail, and commitment by completing assignments efficiently with minimal supervision. * Follow policy, cooperate with supervisors, and align behavior with the goals of the organization. * Exchange information with individuals or groups effectively by listening and responding appropriately. * Overtime may be required with limited compensatory time provided. This is an onsite position only. The State of Iowa participates in E\-Verify, a federal program that helps employers confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. Within the required timeframe, new hires will be verified through the E\-Verify system to ensure authorization to work in the United States. The State of Iowa also complies with the federal Right to Work laws, which protect employees’ rights to work without being required to join a labor organization. For more information, please visit www.e\-verify.gov **Minimum Qualification Requirements** -------------------------------------- • Graduate of a college or university with a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, or Information Services, or minimum of four years relevant work experience.

jobs.title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description: Seattle Hybrid • San Francisco Hybrid Software Engineering Hybrid Full\-time **About Us** ============ Supio is a trusted AI platform purpose\-built for law firms, reshaping how data drives impactful outcomes. Our innovative approach blends technology with deep legal expertise, making us a leader in our field. We go beyond surface\-level AI to deeply understand our customers’ daily needs, empowering law firms with unparalleled data insights. Supio delivers human\-level, accurate analysis of complex data and legal records, quickly and efficiently bringing critical insights when they matter most. Trusted by top litigation lawyers, our platform has supported over $1 billion in settlements. Headquartered in Seattle with an office in San Francisco, we raised $60M Series B in April 2025 led by Sapphire Ventures with Mayfield and Thomson Reuters Ventures, bringing total funding to $91M. We're scaling rapidly and looking for exceptional talent to join us in this next phase of growth. We're looking for passionate team members who are motivated by our mission and ready to help us achieve it. ### **Who We're Looking For** We're looking for a senior infrastructure engineer with real security and compliance depth. You'll join Supio's DevOps team, spend most of your time building and running production infrastructure, and own our security and compliance platform as your area of the team's scope. This role suits someone who has seen how security and compliance work at scale in a larger organization and wants the autonomy to evolve that function at a fast\-growing startup, someone energized by the idea that the data we protect (PII and PHI running through litigation records) is exactly the kind of data that matters most to get right. ### **What You’ll Do** * **Own Infrastructure Compliance:** Own Supio's SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR programs. jobs.title: Staff/Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the company** --------------------- At Swift Solar, our mission is to unlock the full potential of solar energy. We believe solar can provide affordable, reliable, resilient, clean energy to virtually anyone, anywhere. But while today's solar technology is good, it's not good enough. Swift Solar's breakthrough perovskite\-silicon tandem technology will drive solar power to commanding new heights. Our tandem cells stack a perovskite layer on top of a heterojunction (HJT) silicon cell, delivering dramatically higher efficiency than traditional silicon alone. In 2026, we acquired Meyer Burger's HJT intellectual property and manufacturing assets, giving us the world's most extensive HJT patent portfolio and a clear path to gigawatt\-scale domestic production. This vertically integrated approach means we can design, manufacture, and scale next\-generation solar solutions entirely in the United States—from silicon foundations to perovskite innovations. Our technology enables applications ranging from space solar to utility\-scale power generation, creating American\-made solutions for a world facing growing energy challenges. Swift Solar is on a journey to bring revolutionary clean\-energy technology to market. We're in it for the long haul, with support from world\-class investors. Join our extraordinary team building the cutting\-edge solar technology that will power the future. **A day in the life** --------------------- You'll build AI products that assist scientists and accelerate our technical progress towards next\-generation solar solutions. Every experiment we run costs tool time, materials, and scientists' attention, so choosing what to run next is one of the biggest levers on how fast our cells improve. You'll build the AI that helps our scientists make those choices. Our systems read scientific literature and query our lab and manufacturing data, then propose experiment plans that an automated optimizer uses to execute them. You will lead development of the planning and reasoning layer, which takes a research objective as input and uses a multi\-agent system to guide our scientists and reach goals faster through the best selected experiment campaigns. Additionally, we need to measure what works and how frontier models and our own agents perform on problems our team has already worked through, so we can improve the system over time. This is also a place to experiment. When a promising new paper, model, or agent design comes out in AI for science, you can try it here on real problems instead of benchmarks someone else chose. You'll work with scientists who have spent years on perovskites, who know which questions matter and can tell you quickly whether an agent's answer makes sense. Because we develop the process and make the devices ourselves, the data, tools, and people who understand them live in the same company, so an idea can go from your screen to a measured result without waiting on anyone outside. Most of this is greenfield work, and speed matters. You'll get rough versions in front of scientists quickly, watch how they use them, and turn the ideas that hold up into production systems people rely on every day. Knowing when a prototype is ready to harden, and doing it without losing momentum, is a big part of the job. Alongside the agent work, you will: * Hold AI\-written code to a high bar. Nearly all of our code is written with AI coding tools, so critically reviewing the output and keeping the codebase documented and tested matters. * Help keep our existing data systems running, including the pipeline that brings instrument data into our database. * Review code across the team, and help hire and mentor new engineers as the team grows. * Write about what we learn for our public whitepaper series and, when the work holds up, publish it in papers and present it at conferences. **You might be a good fit if you...** ------------------------------------- * Have 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including systems that real users depend on * Have built full\-stack web applications, with a Python backend and a TypeScript/JavaScript frontend (React, Vue, Svelte, or similar) * Have built applications on frontier LLMs through their APIs, such as agents, multi\-step orchestration (e.g., LangGraph), or systems where models call tools * Can take an idea from a quick prototype to a production system that people depend on * Use AI coding tools like Claude Code every day, and can tell when what they produce is wrong * Have a CS degree or a comparable record of open\-source or portfolio work * Write documented, tested code and are comfortable working in a shared codebase with git * Can explain technical tradeoffs to scientists who aren't software engineers * Take initiative and work independently * Are coachable and comfortable when priorities change quickly * Are kind, empathetic, conscientious, and motivated to make an impact on climate change **A strong candidate might bring one or more of the following...** ------------------------------------------------------------------ * Experience with multi\-agent systems, especially ranking, review, or memory between runs * Experience building evaluations or benchmarks for LLM agents * Experience designing complex software architecture and leading projects end\-to\-end without much oversight * Familiarity with Bayesian optimization, surrogate models, fine\-tuning of open\-weights models, or reinforcement\-learning environments * Experience analyzing and plotting scientific data * An interest in science, shown through conferences, side projects, or papers (a science background is not required) * Experience getting skeptical users to adopt internal tools * Experience with SQL or database administration, AWS, Azure, or GCP, or CI/CD * Experience working at a startup **The logistics** ----------------- * Compensation: Competitive package including salary, equity, and benefits * + Expected Pay Range: $150,000 \- $220,000 per year + The actual offer, reflecting total compensation and benefits, will be determined by factors such as relevant experience, skills, and other qualifications * Ideal start date: November \- December 2026 * Job type: Full\-time * Location: San Carlos, CA (Swift Solar HQ), with some remote days possible **What you'll love about Swift** -------------------------------- * **Work with purpose**: Join our mission to unlock the full potential of solar energy and make a global impact. * **Lead with innovation**: Be part of an extraordinary team building cutting\-edge solar technology \- growth mindset; culture * **Thrive with benefits**: Have 100% of your monthly premiums for HMO / PPO group healthcare plan options and 75% of your dental and vision insurance premiums covered by us. Employees also benefit from 401(k) matching, clean commuter benefits, and meaningful equity. * **Invest in your career**: You'll grow your skills, your network, and your perspective at Swift. We'll support you in attending conferences and taking online courses, as long as you share your new insights with the team. We recognize that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often hesitate to apply if they don't meet all the criteria. If you're excited about this role and believe you can contribute to our team, we encourage you to apply—even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We're eager to meet people from all backgrounds, and your unique skills and experiences could be exactly what we need. If you believe in our mission but this isn't the right job for you, please explore other career opportunities on our website and email us at careers@swiftsolar.com with any questions. If you have a friend who would be a perfect fit, share this link with them. Thanks! *Swift is an equal opportunity employer. We value an inclusive work environment and welcome team members of all backgrounds and perspectives.*

You will partner with Tax, Finance, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure our systems provide timely, complete, accurate, and reliable tax information. jobs.title: Prototype Machinist
jobs.description: Therm\-x of California is the leading manufacture for Advanced Temperature and Control Systems for Hi\-Technology industries. We have been in business for over 30 years and have a diverse customer base. **We offer competitive pay, medical, dental, 401 (K), and paid time off.** The Prototype Machinist / NPI Technician works alongside Therm\-x's NPI Engineering team to bring new heater, sensor, source, and cathode designs from drawing to first working part. Our prototyping cell is built around a 5\-axis Okuma mill and a CNC lathe, and it runs separately from the production shop — giving this role the time and autonomy to make new parts the right way the first time. Because most prototypes are one\-off, complex geometries, this is fundamentally a 5\-axis and CAM\-programming role. The job is reading a fresh drawing, programming the toolpath, choosing the right way to hold and cut the part, talking with the design engineer about a tolerance that does not make sense, and shipping a clean first article. The same part is rarely run twice. When the cell is not loaded, this role also supports the NPI team with fixture builds, test setups, and general shop\-floor work. **Responsibilities include, but are not limited to;** * Program, set up, and operate the 5\-axis Okuma mill (and CNC lathe) to produce prototype parts, tools, and fixtures. * Generate efficient CAM programs (Mastercam, HSM, Esprit, NX CAM, or equivalent) from 3D models, including multi\-sided and simultaneous 5\-axis toolpaths. * Verify toolpaths in simulation before cutting; catch collisions, gouges, and reach issues at the CAM stage, not at the spindle. * Select cutting tools, feeds, speeds, and toolpath strategies appropriate for each prototype material and geometry. * Choose appropriate workholding — vises, soft jaws, clamps, custom fixtures, 5\-axis tombstones, and risers — for one\-off and low\-quantity parts. * Read and interpret engineering drawings with GD\&T; confirm critical dimensions and surface finishes. * Inspect parts using calipers, micrometers, height gauges, and other standard inspection tools; record results for First Article Inspection (FAI). * Collaborate directly with mechanical engineers — flag drawing or manufacturability issues early, including DFM input on parts that should be redesigned for 5\-axis efficiency. * Build basic test fixtures and assist NPI engineers with prototype assembly, instrumentation, and data collection. * Maintain a clean, organized, and safe prototyping cell; track tooling, consumables, and machine condition. * Help evaluate new tools, processes, and machines as the prototyping cell evolves. * Support NPI technician work outside the cell as needed: test setups, basic data collection, and general shop\-floor support. **Desired Skills** * Hands\-on 5\-axis CNC milling experience — programming, set\-up, and operation. Okuma (OSP control) strongly preferred; equivalent 5\-axis platforms (DMG MORI, Mazak, Matsuura, Haas UMC) considered. * Strong CAM programming skills — Mastercam, HSM, Esprit, NX CAM, or equivalent — including multi\-sided and simultaneous 5\-axis toolpaths, with the ability to verify and post\-process programs reliably. * Solid grounding in milling principles: cutter selection, feeds and speeds, and how material, tooling, and fixture choices affect part quality on multi\-axis work. * Comfort reading drawings with GD\&T and interpreting tolerances correctly. * Confident use of standard inspection tools: calipers, micrometers, indicators, height gauges. * Computer literacy — opening files, viewing 3D models, running CAM simulations and machine simulations to catch collisions before cutting. * Strong written and verbal communication; able to talk through a drawing with an engineer, not just run parts. * Hands\-on, safety\-first work habits in an active shop environment. **Strong Plus*** Direct experience on Okuma machines and OSP control. * CNC lathe and mill\-turn experience. * Basic 3D modeling (SolidWorks, Inventor, Fusion 360\) and the ability to design simple fixtures. * Probing and in\-process measurement on multi\-axis machines. * Prior NPI or prototype experience, or a job\-shop background with frequent setup changes. **Physical Demands:** While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk or hear and taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. **Work Environment:** high noise level associated with manufacturing facility

jobs.description: Technology Machine Learning Engineer Graduate (Conversational AI) \- 2027 Start **Location :** Seattle **Employment Type :** Regular **Job Code :** A31120 Responsibilities **Team Introduction:** We build the next\-generation unified Agent system for TikTok's global e\-Commerce customer service — running in 30\+ languages across one of the largest e\-Commerce surfaces on the internet. Our north star is a self\-evolving Agent: post\-training, harness, memory / context engineering, tools, and evaluation form one closed loop, and every served conversation becomes the next iteration's training / eval / retrieval / skill\-induction signal. This loop is already running in production — cases are mined, root\-caused, turned into constrained candidates, replayed against frozen regression sets, and shipped behind guardrails. Two things make this team different from most "LLM application" work: \- We build the agent runtime itself — Codex / Claude\-Code\-class — not prompts on top of a vendor API. \- Evaluation and experimentation are first\-class systems, not an afterthought. A self\-improving loop optimizes whatever signal you give it, so the hardest and most valuable engineering here is making the judgment trustworthy — not just making the model change. By combining generative recommendation, large recommendation models, multimodal representation learning, and cross\-domain value modeling, the team works on some of the most important algorithmic problems in live commerce. Our goal is to improve user experience, optimize ecosystem efficiency, and drive sustainable business growth for TikTok Shop across global markets. We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth. Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume. Candidates can apply to a maximum of two positions and will be considered for jobs in the order you apply. The application limit is applicable to our Company and its affiliates' jobs globally. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis \- we encourage you to apply early. Responsibilities: \- Agent runtime (harness / agent loop). Orchestrate skills, tools, and context; implement loop control \& intervention, progressive disclosure, and behavior\-level guardrails. Build the production safety layer — pre\-flight budgets and timeout truncation, serve\-time gates, shadow / swap\-in answer delivery, and safe fallback paths. \- Context \& memory for long multi\-turn agents. Agentic memory (structured note\-taking), context compaction / summarization, context editing / observation masking, and just\-in\-time (retrieve\-then\-load) retrieval. Treat context as an evolving, itemized playbook — with structured diffs and a deterministic curator — rather than an ever\-growing prompt. \- Post\-training \& the data flywheel. SFT / DPO / RL to internalize rules into weights (so the prompt gets shorter, not longer), plus distillation to smaller serving models. Turn served conversations into training / eval / retrieval signals. \- Tools, Skills, and MCP. Tools\-as\-APIs, connectors, skill / tool search for large inventories, and skill\-library governance — description conflicts, trigger evals, cross\-skill mis\-fire matrices, and on\-demand loading instead of dumping every definition into context. \- Evaluation you can bet a launch on. LLM\-as\-judge with human\-agreement calibration; statistical rigor — paired comparison, confidence intervals, repeated sampling, pass^k; held\-out and time\-rolling eval splits with overfitting alarms; cascaded scoring and cross\-family judge panels to make evaluation affordable at scale. \- The self\-evolving loop. Case mining → automatic root\-cause → constrained candidate generation → replay verification against frozen regression sets → canary → flywheel. Build the plumbing that makes it auditable: candidate registry with exact runtime read\-back, change lineage, and an archive of rejected candidates you can sample from next round. \- Online experimentation \& causal readout. Shadow / canary / A\-B, non\-inferiority gates, traffic\-split health, metric definitions that survive scrutiny, and off\-policy counterfactual evaluation where live A/B isn't possible. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Android
jobs.description: **About the Role:** Engages with stakeholders across teams to lead the design, development, and evolution of the build systems and CI infrastructure that every Android engineer at Uber depends on. Every change to Uber's Android apps \- Rider, Driver, Uber Eats, and more \- flows through the build. In this role, you will own the Android build end to end: the Bazel build graph and rules, remote caching, and the CI pipelines that verify every change before it lands. You will set the technical direction for making Android builds faster, more reliable, and more cost\-efficient at monorepo scale, and lead cross\-team initiatives to achieve these goals. What You'll Do: * Own the Android build end to end \- the Bazel build graph, Starlark rules and toolchains (Android, Kotlin, Java), and dependency management across a large, multi\-app Android monorepo. * Drive down CI and local build latency through remote build caching and remote execution, build\-graph pruning, critical\-path parallelism, and cost\-aware CI sharding. * Make local and CI results consistent, so a green local build, test, or lint result means a green CI run. * Make every build failure actionable: eliminate flakiness and cache\-correctness issues, add per\-target telemetry and smarter retry policies, and ensure engineers and AI coding agents know what failed, how to fix it, and who to contact. * Keep the Android build modern: lead Bazel upgrades, Kotlin and Android toolchain upgrades, and dependency\-automation (Gazelle) rollouts as coordinated, low\-disruption initiatives. * Shrink the workload, not just speed it up: partner on smart test selection over the shared Bazel graph so each change runs only the tests it can affect, without sacrificing quality. * Define and track build health \- latency, success rate, cache hit rate, and flakiness \- and catch regressions before developers feel them. * Lead through influence: write design documents, set standards, mentor engineers, lead build incident response, and partner with Android Platform, CI Platform, and product teams to deliver improvements across the organization. **About the Team:** Core Build is Uber's centralized build platform team. We own the common build infrastructure \- Bazel, Gazelle, build rules, client\-side remote build caching and execution, and shared build/test CI pipelines \- across Uber's Java, Go, Android, iOS, and Web monorepos. Our vision is simple: make builds fast with less friction. Because the stack is shared, an improvement we make once benefits every engineer at Uber. We work across three pillars: * **Velocity:** Make builds faster everywhere with fewer resources \- in CI, remote development environments, and on laptops \- through caching, remote execution, sharding, and build\-graph optimization. * **Reliability \& Diagnosability:** A build failure should never leave an engineer stranded. Every failure should communicate what failed, how to fix it, and who can help. * **Modernization, Unification \& Scale:** Keep the platform on the latest Bazel, maximize CI fleet utilization with smart test selection and build\-graph pruning, and apply GenAI/ML to automate diagnosis and optimization. Our next major initiative is to stop compiling the same code thousands of times: make mobile builds remote\-first, so a local build becomes a download rather than a compile, and run only the tests a change can actually affect. As the Staff Android Engineer on the team, you will be the technical owner for the Android side of this roadmap. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years of full\-time engineering experience. * Systematic problem\-solving approach and knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis. * Strong understanding of Android development. **Preferred Technical Skills:** * Deep, hands\-on experience with Bazel (or Buck) for Android builds: Starlark rules, rules\_android / rules\_kotlin, build\-graph and dependency management. * Remote build caching and remote execution (Remote Execution API; e.g., Buildbarn, BuildBuddy, EngFlow). * Android build internals: Gradle, D8/R8, resource processing, and Kotlin compiler / annotation\-processing performance. * CI systems at scale (e.g., Buildkite): sharding, test orchestration, and flaky\-test management. * Build performance analysis and observability (Bazel profiles, Build Event Protocol, metrics, and regression dashboards). * Leading large\-scale build migrations or upgrades (e.g., Buck/Gradle to Bazel, Bazel major versions, bzlmod). * Tooling development in Kotlin/Java. * Applying LLMs/AI agents to developer tooling (e.g., automated build\-failure diagnosis). jobs.title: Manager of Platform Engineering
jobs.description: **Manager of Platform Engineering** =================================== **Location:** Charlotte, NC (Onsite) **Reporting to:** Chief Technology Officer (CTO) **About Velocitor Solutions** ----------------------------- Velocitor Solutions is a leader in enterprise fleet management and mobile innovation, celebrating over 25 years of profitably growing technology. We go beyond standard telematics by offering a comprehensive, managed ecosystem—managing over 200,000 mobile assets for Fortune 500 clients across North America. Our V\-Track platform integrates GPS tracking, AI\-powered video telematics, and real\-time data to drive safety and efficiency. We are in a pivotal phase of growth and looking to expand technology team. **Why Join Velocitor Solutions** -------------------------------- Take charge of the platform that enables 24x7 fleet operations for leading enterprises, where your leadership drives both customer success and business growth. In this role, you’ll stay hands\-on with technology while shaping strategy, building, and mentoring a high\-performing team as Velocitor scales and modernizes its tech stack. Reporting directly to the CTO, you’ll collaborate with executive leadership, tackle challenges like Kubernetes at scale, CI/CD modernization, and platform reliability, and ensure engineering excellence in a dynamic, growth\-focused environment. **Role Summary** ---------------- The Manager of Platform Engineering leads the engineering team responsible for Velocitor’s customer\-facing platform—owning DevOps, site reliability, and deployment practices that keep the platform available, secure, and scalable on Azure. This hands\-on management role balances technical execution with team leadership, including building and mentoring a high\-performing engineering team, advancing CI/CD and Kubernetes maturity, embedding SRE and security practices, and supporting the company’s rapid growth. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Leadership \& Strategy** * Build, mentor, and retain a team of platform engineers across DevOps and site reliability engineering, providing technical coaching, career development, and performance management. * Own platform strategy, roadmap, and execution to meet business goals and customer SLAs * Ensure adherence to engineering KPIs (availability, MTTR, deployment frequency, change success rate, incident volume) and present regular updates to the CTO. * Take full ownership of platform strategy, roadmap, and execution aligned with business objectives, product needs, and customer SLAs. * Establish operational cadence: incident reviews, change advisory board, release reviews, team retrospectives, and continuous improvement culture. ### **Platform Operations \& Architecture** * Own the design, implementation, and 24x7 operation of Velocitor's hybrid infrastructure (Azure \+ on\-premise) supporting both production and internal corporate systems. * Ensure high availability, scalability, performance, security, and cost efficiency across all environments. * Hands\-on architecture and implementation of cloud infrastructure, networking, identity management (Azure AD/Entra, RBAC), storage, backup, monitoring, and observability. * Drive cloud optimization initiatives: rightsizing, reserved capacity, architectural improvements, and cost governance across Azure workloads. * Define and enforce platform standards for networking, security, identity, logging, alerting, and operational discipline. ### **DevOps \& Site Reliability Engineering** * Lead DevOps and SRE transformation: implement CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM/Bicep), containerization (Kubernetes), and modern deployment practices * Hands\-on implementation of Kubernetes clusters, container orchestration, service mesh, and cloud\-native architecture patterns * Establish SRE principles: error budgets, SLOs/SLIs, blameless postmortems, observability (metrics/logs/traces), and reliability engineering culture * Build and optimize CI/CD tooling and workflows to improve release velocity, reduce deployment risk, and increase developer productivity * Implement robust change management processes (risk assessment, testing, communication, rollback procedures) that balance speed, safety, and audit readiness ### **Information Security \& Compliance** * Implement security and compliance controls, including access management, logging and monitoring, vulnerability management, incident response, and audit evidence collection. * Establish security best practices across infrastructure: network segmentation, firewall rules, encryption (data at rest/in transit), secrets management, privileged access management. * Lead incident response for infrastructure and platform issues, including root cause analysis, remediation, and process improvements. * Own Disaster Recovery strategy and execution: define RPO/RTO targets, architect multi\-region and hybrid DR solutions, develop runbooks, and conduct regular DR testing * Ensure backup and restore capabilities across all critical systems with documented procedures and validated recovery processes **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 7\+ years of progressive experience in platform, DevOps, or software engineering, with at least 2–3 years leading or managing an engineering team. * Deep expertise with Microsoft Azure platform services including compute (App Services, Functions, VMs), containers (AKS), identity (Azure AD/Entra, RBAC), security, and monitoring. * Proven track record building and supporting highly available, mission\-critical customer\-facing platforms at enterprise scale. * Strong background in security and compliance, with experience implementing controls * Demonstrated leadership of DevOps/SRE teams with hands\-on experience building CI/CD pipelines, managing Kubernetes clusters, implementing Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM/Bicep), and operating observability platforms * Solid understanding and ownership of change management processes (ITIL or similar) including change advisory boards, risk assessment, and audit\-ready documentation. * Proven ability to recruit, develop, and retain high\-performing technical teams with a coaching\-oriented leadership style * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills—ability to translate technical complexity into business impact for executive and non\-technical audiences * Thrives in fast\-paced, dynamic environments with rapidly changing priorities and ambiguity * Strong ownership mentality: you take accountability for outcomes, drive issues to resolution, and lead by example **Preferred Skills** -------------------- * Experience in B2B SaaS, telematics, fleet management, IoT, or other real\-time, data\-intensive platforms serving enterprise customers * Experience with observability and monitoring platforms (Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus/Grafana, Azure Monitor, Application Insights) * Background supporting real\-time GPS tracking, vehicle telematics, or IoT device management platforms * Relevant certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) * Experience scaling platforms to support rapid business growth (2x–3x revenue in 2–3 years) * Prior experience operating in regulated or compliance\-driven environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, FedRAMP) * Hands\-on experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar CI/CD platforms * Understanding of fleet management industry compliance requirements (FMCSA, ELD mandates, hours\-of\-service regulations) **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- * Competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications. * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance. * Paid time off and holidays. * Retirement savings plan options. * Opportunities for career advancement and professional growth. *This job jobs.title: Lead Embedded Firmware Engineer - US (Full Time)
jobs.description: **About Very** ============== *(Remote – United States)* ========================== Very is a fully distributed technology firm led by expert problem\-solvers who create efficient, scalable solutions that move commercial, industrial, and consumer products from pilot to production in record time. We believe that real innovation happens **in the grind** — working shoulder to shoulder with clients who are building the future. Our team thrives on that energy. When we’re not helping clients deliver business\-critical outcomes, we’re refining our craft and celebrating what it means to do hard things well. We’ve built a collaborative, tight\-knit culture that thrives in both remote and in\-person settings. We’ve won numerous workplace awards over the years, including Great Place to Work certification and recognition from Parity.org as a Best Company for Women to Advance. Our clients include well\-known brands like Vizio, Peloton, Clear, iHeart Radio, and Fellowes — all determined to leverage connected devices and AI to drive meaningful impact. Our job is simple: **help them win.** **About This Role** We are seeking a Lead Firmware engineer with 8\+ years of professional embedded development experience who has deep expertise building production embedded systems on modern wireless MCU platforms such as Espressif ESP32\. In this role, you’ll own the device firmware stack end to end, from schematic review and board bring\-up through production firmware, OTA, and certification, while setting technical direction and mentoring the engineers around you. **What You’ll Be Working On** We dedicate each engineer to a single project in order to promote focus and minimize context switching. You will be developing production\-grade firmware for connected devices from bring\-up through production deployment and ongoing maintenance. You will own firmware development across the full device lifecycle, including schematic review, board bring\-up, driver integration, BLE provisioning, cloud connectivity, OTA updates, and certification readiness. You will also participate in hardware debugging and validation using tools such as JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, and protocol sniffers to diagnose low\-level issues across firmware, hardware, and network layers. You’ll lead firmware technical decisions and collaborate closely with hardware engineers, contract manufacturers, client stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to deliver production\-ready devices. This role involves debugging complex, real\-world interoperability issues across connected\-device ecosystems, requiring deep protocol\-level understanding and hands\-on problem solving. **Responsibilities** * Own firmware architecture and technical direction, making key design decisions and tradeoffs * Serve as the primary firmware point of contact for the client, translating product requirements into technical plans and estimates * Plan and prioritize firmware work, identifying risks and dependencies early * Lead code reviews and set firmware coding, testing, and release standards * Mentor and guide other engineers on the team * Design, develop, and maintain production firmware for ESP32\-based connected devices using ESP\-IDF * Bring up new hardware and integrate drivers for sensors, actuators, LEDs, and other peripherals * Implement BLE provisioning, Wi\-Fi connectivity, and secure cloud communication with AWS IoT Core over MQTT * Build and maintain reliable OTA update mechanisms, including rollback and staged rollouts * Debug and resolve issues across firmware, hardware, wireless, and cloud layers, from development through production * Partner with hardware engineers and contract manufacturers on factory flashing, device provisioning, and production readiness * Support certification (e.g., FCC) and hardware build phases (EVT/DVT/PVT) * Collaborate with mobile and backend teams on device data models, telemetry, and device\-to\-cloud interfaces * Establish standards for firmware CI/CD, test tooling, and technical documentation **Requirements** **Experience** * 8\+ years professional embedded/firmware engineering in C/C\+\+ * 2\+ years in a technical lead role, owning firmware architecture decisions, leading code reviews, and mentoring other engineers. * Experience working directly with clients or stakeholders to scope, estimate, and plan firmware work. * Significant experience with Espressif ESP32 platforms using ESP\-IDF, including RTOS\-based development, OTA update mechanisms, low\-level driver integration (I2C, SPI, UART, ADC, GPIO), and production firmware deployment. * Direct, demonstrable experience developing connected\-device firmware on modern wireless platforms such as ESP32, including Bluetooth Low Energy, Wi\-Fi, and related connectivity technologies. * Hands\-on experience with wireless communication stacks such as BLE and Wi\-Fi at the firmware level. * Experience debugging protocol\-level communication issues, wireless connectivity problems, device provisioning flows, and interoperability challenges in connected\-device ecosystems. * Experience connecting devices to cloud IoT platforms such as AWS IoT Core using MQTT over TLS, including certificate\-based authentication and device state synchronization. * Experience integrating sensors, actuators, and peripherals such as RFID readers, accelerometers, motion sensors, LEDs, and pumps. * Comfortable reading technical specifications and translating them into production\-quality firmware implementations. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience leading firmware for a connected product from concept through mass production * Contributions to open\-source ESP\-IDF or nRF Connect SDK project * Background in adjacent protocols — Thread, Zigbee, Z\-Wave, BLE Mesh — demonstrating breadth across the connected device landscape * History of working in a consultancy or product development firm where they've shipped across multiple product lines, not just one internal product * Comfort with hardware debug toolchains — JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, protocol sniffers * Experience standing up CI/CD for firmware builds and automated test harnesses * Experience with Nordic nRF\-series platforms using nRF Connect SDK * Familiarity with embedded security concepts such as secure boot, flash encryption, key management, device attestation, and secure firmware updates * Experience designing OTA update strategies with rollback and staged rollouts * Experience working with contract manufacturers on factory flashing, device provisioning, and production readiness * Experience supporting hardware through EVT/DVT/PVT builds and FCC certification * Familiarity with Protocol Buffers or similar serialization formats for device messaging * Python scripting for test tooling and device automation **Skills** ---------- * **Client Obsessed:** Acts as the client’s trusted technical voice and keeps them confident in delivery. * **Communicates Clearly:** Turns complex technical tradeoffs into clear recommendations for any audience. * **Thrives in the Grind:** Leads from the front on hard problems and sets the bar for detail. * **Learns Relentlessly:** Grows fast and helps the team grow through mentoring and shared lessons. * **Brings Structure:** Sets the plans, standards and priorities that keep the team on track. **Compensation \& Benefits** **Base Compensation:** $175,000 USD, commensurate with experience. **Variable Compensation:** Up to 10% annual performance bonus \*\*Note: To qualify for this role, you must reside within the continental US and have proper work authorization. We do not sponsor work visas. **Perks \& Benefits:** * 401(k) match * 200/month cell phone \+ internet stipend * $600/year home office stipend * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Paid parental leave (95th percentile in the U.S.) * Professional development stipend * Loaned MacBook Pro * Annual team retreat **Why Work for Very** --------------------- We do not promise an easy ride — we promise meaningful work. We work hard because our clients’ success depends on it, and we take pride in delivering when others can’t. We collaborate closely, move fast, and stay grounded in results. We take joy in the process — in the problem\-solving, the iteration, and the shared wins that come from doing the hard things well. If you’re looking for a place where every project matters, where the standards are high, and where you’ll grow by pushing yourself and others — welcome to Very. Interviewing for a new company is a serious time commitment for all parties involved. Please take the time to read this and thoughtfully consider if we would be a good fit for one another. No contractors or agencies. Seriously. \#LI\-Remote **\*\*Note: To qualify for this role, you must reside within the region posted.** **\*\*Note: This role requires the ability to travel within the US as needed for client engagements.** **\*\*We do not provide visa sponsorship.\*\*** 2RgOiOWezM

Part\-time employees who are in pay status during the month of the holiday qualify for the holiday on a pro\-rata basis. Compensation for holidays (including personal holiday) will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status in the month to that required for full\-time employment, excluding all holiday hours. Pay status includes hours worked and time on paid leave. **Sick Leave** Full\-time employees earn eight hours of sick leave per month. jobs.title: AI Automation Developer II
jobs.description: Overview: To be part of our organization, every employee should understand and share in the YNHHS Vision, support our Mission, and live our Values. These values \- integrity, patient\-centered, respect, accountability, and compassion \- must guide what we do, as individuals and professionals, every day. Support the design, development, and deployment of automation solutions for healthcare operations. Build Python\-based services and workflow automations that improve clinical, operational, and financial processes, including integration with enterprise and EHR/EMR systems. Apply technical expertise in automation development, healthcare IT/interoperability, and agile delivery to provide scalable, secure, and reliable digital workflows under the guidance of the Automation Architect. EEO/AA/Disability/Veteran Responsibilities: * Collaborate with the Automation Architect and cross\-functional stakeholders (clinical operations, finance, IT, analytics) to perform discovery, translate requirements into technical workflows, and prioritize high\-ROI automations. * Design, develop, and maintain Python scripts, services, and tools that automate clinical and operational workflows (revenue cycle, scheduling, reporting, user provisioning), including robust exception handling, logging, and retries. * Develop and implement automation solutions using Automation Anywhere when appropriate and custom\-built platforms (e.g., Django/YDA, Playwright), applying workflow orchestration, queues, schedulers, and asynchronous processing. * Build and maintain scalable automation frameworks leveraging best\-of\-breed tools and patterns (e.g., Django Admin, Playwright, CouchDB, REST APIs), ensuring maintainability, testability, and reuse. * Develop and support EHR/EMR integrations and interoperability workflows (e.g., Epic), including API\-based integrations and HL7 v2 / FHIR interfaces; manage message ingest, mapping, validation, and routing. * Build and support ETL/data pipelines between clinical systems, data platforms/warehouses, and downstream applications; ensure data quality, lineage, and reliable downstream consumption. * Monitor automation executions and data pipelines; implement health checks, alerting, and observability; troubleshoot, debug, and optimize for performance, reliability, and scalability. * Ensure compliance with HIPAA and organizational security policies, including access controls and secure data handling; support audits and regulatory reviews by providing logs, documentation, and evidence of controls. * Provide support to internal users, including training on new automated workflows and assisting with adoption and change management. Participate in proof\-of\-concept initiatives and pilot programs to validate automation strategies; measure outcomes (time saved, error reduction, operational impact) and iterate. * Create and maintain technical documentation (technical specs, flow diagrams, runbooks, SOPs) and contribute to operational procedures and support readiness. Seek mentorship and guidance from the Automation Architect and senior engineers; continuously improve engineering practices. Qualifications: EDUCATION Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Health Informatics, Data Science/Statistics, or related field \- or significant automation development experience in a healthcare production environment in lieu of a specific degree. EXPERIENCE * Minimum of three (3\) years hands\-on experience in software engineering, workflow automation, or digital transformation, ideally in healthcare or another regulated industry. * Demonstrated success delivering production automations end\-to\-end (design, build, deploy, monitor, and optimize), including Python\-based services/scripts and/or RPA\-style workflows with strong exception handling, logging, retries, and operational support. * Experience integrating with enterprise systems and EHR/EMR workflows (e.g., Epic) using vendor APIs and/or healthcare interoperability standards (HL7 v2, FHIR), and building ETL/data pipelines between operational systems and downstream data platforms. * Strong collaboration skills with cross\-functional teams and the ability to lead or contribute to proof\-of\-concept efforts while ensuring solutions meet privacy and security standards (e.g., HIPAA). Exceptional candidates with significant, relevant internship experience may also be considered. LICENSURE * Certifications preferred at the time of application: Lean Six Sigma White Belt Certified Scrum Developer (CSD) * Certification required by the 6\-month review: PCPP1 Certified Professional Python Programmer Level 1 * Additional certifications are preferred but not required. Relevant examples include Automation Anywhere, UiPath, or Blue Prism; cloud certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP); and healthcare IT/interoperability training or credentials (HL7, FHIR, HIPAA/privacy). SPECIAL SKILLS * Ability to develop and implement automation solutions across the software development lifecycle in regulated, large\-scale environments. * Strong Python and SQL skills; familiarity with RESTful APIs, microservices, and event\-driven architecture; and experience with workflow orchestration (queues, schedulers, asynchronous jobs, retries, and observability). * Working knowledge of healthcare data and interoperability concepts (HL7 v2, FHIR) and experience integrating automations with EHR systems (Epic) is highly desirable. * Proficiency with CI/CD, Git\-based development, testing practices, and containerization technologies (Docker; Kubernetes preferred) is a plus. * Ability to create clear technical documentation (specs, runbooks, diagrams), support troubleshooting/root\-cause analysis, and communicate effectively with non\-technical stakeholders. PHYSICAL DEMAND On\-call: Participates in a scheduled on\-call rotation for production automations and integrations. Includes nights/weekends/holidays as scheduled; responds according to department SLOs and incident severity. Go\-live support: Provides hyper care during planned cutovers and release windows, which may require after\-hours and extended shifts, occasional onsite presence, and coordination of command\-center/war\-room activities, back\-out readiness, and post\-go\-live stabilization.
